name: Cuba
best_time_to_visit: Generally November–April; check current weather and hurricane advisories
hero_credit: Old Havana street · Nick Kenrick · CC BY 2.0
intro: Cuba is an island country where historic streets, Afro-Cuban music, and Caribbean landscapes meet. In Havana, a **plaza** (public square) and the **malecón** (seafront promenade) are part of everyday city life.
fun_fact: UNESCO notes that Havana was founded around 1519 and retains its original urban layout and **fortaleza** (fortress) network, including five historic plazas.

cultura.name: Rumba
cultura.description:
A communal music-and-dance tradition shaped by African, Antillean, and Spanish influences.
The **guaguancó** (rumba style) and call-and-response carry **rumba** (music and dance) forward.

cultura.name: Son cubano
cultura.description:
Guitar, tres, bass, and percussion create a sound that travelled widely.
The **son** (Cuban music style) depends on a repeating **clave** (rhythmic pattern).

cultura.name: Tumba francesa
cultura.description:
Societies preserve a distinctive blend of African and French-Caribbean heritage.
Drums, singing, and dance make this UNESCO-recognized tradition a living practice.

cultura.name: Bolero
cultura.description:
This romantic song form emerged in eastern Cuba in the nineteenth century.
A **bolero** (slow romantic song) often centres on expressive voice and guitar.

india_traveller.visa_note: Entry rules depend on passport and travel purpose. Indian travellers should confirm tourist-visa eligibility, application steps, passport validity, and any required arrival form with the Cuban mission serving India before booking.
india_traveller.flight_note: There are no assumed direct India–Havana services in this guide. Compare live routes via international hubs, check transit-visa rules for every stop, and confirm current schedules before paying. Local **guagua** (bus) services may help with short trips.
india_traveller.cost_per_day_inr: About INR 8,000–15,000 per person for **alojamiento** (lodging), meals, and local travel; keep **efectivo** (cash) for purchases and budget a **propina** (tip). Excludes international flights and visa fees.
india_traveller.veg_tips: Ask whether beans or rice were cooked with lard, stock, **cerdo** (pork), or other meat. A **paladar** (private restaurant) may be able to adapt a dish; confirm ingredients clearly.
india_traveller.key_food_phrase: Sin carne ni pescado, por favor

verification_notes: Visa and arrival requirements for Indian passport holders must be confirmed with Cuban consular authorities; the linked eVisa portal does not itself confirm nationality-specific eligibility.
INR daily-cost and flight notes are planning estimates, exclude international airfare, and should be checked against current availability and exchange rates.
research_reflection: Havana's **patrimonio** (heritage) is only one part of Cuba's story: music, rural landscapes, and everyday neighbourhood life deserve equal attention in a short travel guide.
